verdict.rationale: A tax agency can publish developer tooling, and it has a 'For Tax Software Developers' page, so this story applies. However, the evidence shows no official SDK. The only developer-facing material is IRS-style XML schema formats for 1099 uploads, which is a file format rather than an SDK. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, and filings sit behind an interactive authenticated portal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
